newsitem.title: USA: Rexene says gives Huntsman access to records.
newsitem.headline: Rexene says gives Huntsman access to records.

text.p: Rexene Corp said Tuesday it will give privately held Huntsman Corp access to its non-public information as long as it signs a confidentiality agreement.
Rexene said Huntsman must also confirm in writing its interest in buying the company for $16 per share in cash, and that it has obtained the necessary financing.
The company said it is giving Huntsman access to the records in response to a request to conduct a due diligence review before making a bid to acquire it.
Rexene said it is granting the request because it is "committed to exploring all options to maximize stockholder value."
Rexene said it will coordinate a time for the review once Huntsman signs and returns the agreement.
